content.content: Did you know that Elton John's duet with RuPaul, "Don't Go Breaking My Heart," was released in 1993 as part of the album "Duets"? This pop rendition of the classic 1976 hit, originally by Elton John and Kiki Dee, was featured in the 1999 film "Summer of Sam." The song's unique blend of Elton's signature style with RuPaul's energetic vocals made it a memorable cover, showcasing the enduring appeal of this timeless duet.
content.title: Don't Go Breaking My Heart

alternatives.text: Did you know that "Don't Go Breaking My Heart" by RuPaul is a cover of the famous duet by Elton John and Kiki Dee? Released in 1993 as part of RuPaul's album "Duets," this pop rendition put a fresh spin on the beloved classic. With RuPaul's iconic style and energetic performance, the song became a hit and showcased the drag queen's versatility as a musician. It's a fun and vibrant interpretation that pays homage to the original while adding a unique flair that only RuPaul could bring to the table.
